RAPT (formerly FLX Bio, founded 2015, the firm's since-year). Rebellion Defense (defence software, Washington DC). Nextgov: a Series B of more than $150M in September 2021 at $1.15B, the last priced mark (over 24 months old), aligned with Insight. The firm's since-year is 2019, the company's first year; its 2019 round is not named on record.

relayr (industrial IoT) was founded and headquartered in Berlin; the prefilled US country is its Boston subsidiary's Form D address (One Boston Place). Renmatix (cellulosic sugars, 660 Allendale Road, King of Prussia per its 2015 Form D), still private on record with a 2020 raise. The firm's Greentech listing starts in 2012 and the band reads a 2015 Form D. The base also carries it as sriya-innovations-inc, its former name.
Rent the Runway is headquartered in Brooklyn, New York, as Bain Capital Ventures and TCV carry it.

Ring (Santa Monica) was acquired by Amazon in 2018. The firm's since-year is 2016, after the December 2014 Series A and the $28M 2015 round (First Round's note), so a later round: Growth, as the site also labels it; KP's own round is not cited.
The firm's post of 2019-04-03: 'We couldn't be more excited to lead Rippling's Series A'; its 2024 case study repeats that KP started at the Series A (Mamoon Hamid, Ilya Fushman).

Robinhood's release of 2018-05-10: the $363M Series D led by DST Global 'with participation from new investors Iconiq, Capital G, Sequoia Capital, and Kleiner Perkins', the firm's 2018 entry. Nasdaq HOOD, market cap $101.15B on 2026-09-30 (StockAnalysis).

RPX (defensive patent aggregation, San Francisco) was founded in 2008 and 'initially financed by Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers, Charles River Ventures, and Index Ventures' (Wikipedia), the firm's 2008 since-year: the first institutional round, read as Series A. Taken private by HGGC in 2018.

The firm's post of 2021-06-10: 'we are leading RudderStack's Series A' (founded 2019, seed from S28). Momentum check 2026-09-30 (Google News): the $21M Series A (June 2021) and $56M Series B (February 2022) are the last reported rounds; no priced round at $1B.

Sagimet (formerly 3-V Biosciences, San Mateo). The firm's since-year is 2007; its draft S-1 names KPCB among the backers but covers only recent rounds, so the entry round is not named. The duplicate 3-v-biosciences row is skipped in this run.

The firm's post of 2021-03-18 (URL 'secureframe-series-a') announces its partnership at Secureframe's Series A, matching the 2021 since-year. Compliance automation, San Francisco; no priced round at $1B known.

Segment (customer data platform, San Francisco) was bought by Twilio in 2020 for $3.2B. The firm's since-year is 2013, between the NEA/General Catalyst seed and Accel's 2014-15 round (Headline's note); the 2013 round is not named on record.

Segway (Bedford, New Hampshire) was founded in 1999; John Doerr invested in it (Wikipedia), long before the band's $40,000 Form D of 2009, which cannot be the firm's entry. Sold to Summit in 2013 and to Ninebot in 2015. The founding-era round is not named on record.

ServiceMax (field-service software, Pleasanton) was founded in 2007 and funded from 2008 (Wikipedia); the firm entered in 2014 from the Green Growth Fund (archived page), a late round, so Growth. GE bought it in 2016 and PTC in January 2023 (Wikipedia).

SessionM (mobile engagement and loyalty, Boston) was acquired by Mastercard in 2019, the acquirer the firm's page names. The firm entered in 2011 from the iFund (archived page, Matt Murphy); the round is not named on record.
Shape Security was acquired by F5 in 2020 for about $1B, the acquirer the firm's page names; Mountain View as in the GV book. Graduation left for the graduation pass.

Wikipedia: Shazam's success 'led to a funding round from Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers in October 2009' (iFund), matching the firm's 2009 since-year; Shazam (founded 1999) had earlier venture rounds, so Growth. The band's 2015 Form D is a later round. Apple bought Shazam in 2018.

Shyp (on-demand shipping, San Francisco) shut down in 2018.
Siluria (natural gas to ethylene and fuels, San Francisco) was bought by McDermott in 2019 (Wikipedia; Lux carries the same). Graduation left for the graduation pass.

SpinLaunch (kinetic space launch) is headquartered in Long Beach (Wikipedia), still private after its 2025 raise; about $150M raised by 2022, no priced round at $1B known.
